title: Re-align MAP project vision, current state, and active execution lanes
description: Operator directive 2026-07-22: agents have been operating from different stages of MAP evolution. Reconcile approved decisions, executable state, active tasks, and agent authority into one concise current operating picture; refresh stale canonical summaries without inventing architecture or erasing history.
acceptance_criteria: A concise durable alignment memo states the approved project vision and non-goals using current decisions and executable evidence.
The memo reconciles every active task, current owner/lane, dependency or gate, and recommended execution order.
project-brief.md and current-state.md are refreshed only where verified facts have changed, with current metadata and links to authoritative decisions.
Agent roles and authority boundaries are explicit: Codex/Claude core, Pi exploratory-only, helpers bounded/visible, operator attention reserved for decisions and risks.
Validators pass and an independent reviewer can verify every claimed current-state fact.
